items.title: Your Boss Won't Buy It? Say This
items.summary: In episode 1015 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Jerry Yurchisin, Manager of Decision Intelligence Strategy at Gurobi Optimization about how to communicate the benefits of mathematical optimization to CFOs and CEOs. Jerry advises highlighting the clear differences between optimization and LLMs, focusing on optimization's ability to provide monetary value and direct impact on the bottom line, rather than just small productivity increases, to gain leadership buy-in for new projects.

items.title: From Local AI Agent to Production System
items.summary:
Running an agent locally is one thing. Deploying an agentic system that real users depend on is something else entirely.

In this Short, Micheal Lanham, author of AI Agents in Action, Second Edition, explains what changes when agents move into production: reliability, observability, security, cost control, latency, user trust, failure recovery, and operational ownership.

Learn more about the book: https://hubs.la/Q04p-7WX0

#AIAgents #AgenticAI #AIEngineering #LLM #ManningBooks

items.title: AI agent to run and grow your business.
Firebird Launches CIS Region’s Largest AI Factory in Armenia
items.summary:
NVIDIA pioneered accelerated computing to tackle problems beyond the reach of ordinary computers and is working with AI cloud partners to expand access to AI factories around the world.

Watch NVIDIA Founder and CEO Jensen Huang celebrate Firebird’s launch of the CIS region’s largest AI factory in Armenia, establishing a new AI computing hub powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing and Dell Technologies high-performance AI infrastructure. The project is intended to bring global demand for AI infrastructure, local development opportunities, and new economic growth to the region

➡️ Learn more: https://blogs.nvidia.com/blog/firebird-ai-factory-armenia-blackwell-rubin-dsx
